notes: M2-to-M1 macrophage polarization rate. COVERAGE GAP: 3/4 existing targets use pharmacological stimulus (RP-182, IL-12, LPS+IFNg), giving drug-induced rates 20-160x above the endogenous rate. Only 1/4 targets (CD40_2021 steady-state ratio) measures endogenous polarization. Need: endogenous/pathological-state M1:M2 ratio from clinical PDAC tissue (IHC or mIF) from an independent cohort to anchor the basal polarization rate. Look for studies reporting CD86/CD163 or iNOS/CD206 ratios in resected PDAC. The model parameter is k_M1_pol in units 1/day.

M2-to-M1 macrophage polarization rate. Need: in vivo TAM polarization dynamics WITHOUT exogenous pharmacological stimulus. Look for syngeneic PDAC mouse models (KPC, Panc02) reporting temporal M1/M2 ratio changes during tumor progression, or macrophage fate-mapping studies tracking M2-to-M1 conversion rates in the tumor microenvironment. Pathological state or physiological baseline perturbation type. Model parameter is k_M1_pol in 1/day.

CCL2 secretion rate. COVERAGE GAP: all 3 existing targets are in vitro ELISA from cell lines (isolated process). Zero in vivo/clinical targets. Need: PDAC tumor interstitial fluid or serum CCL2 concentrations in patients, which can be combined with estimated tumor cell density to derive a per-cell secretion rate. Look for studies measuring CCL2 levels in resected PDAC tissue (ELISA or Luminex on tumor lysate), or paired serum CCL2 measurements with tumor volume. Model parameter is k_CCL2_sec in nanomole/cell/day.

CCL2 secretion rate. Need: primary human PDAC cancer-associated fibroblast (CAF) or PSC culture CCL2 ELISA. Existing targets use non-PDAC cell lines (monocytic leukemia, breast cancer, PrSC). A primary PDAC CAF culture would be same cell type in same disease context. Look for studies culturing patient-derived PDAC CAFs/PSCs and measuring CCL2 in conditioned media. Model parameter is k_CCL2_sec in nanomole/cell/day.

MDSC recruitment rate into tumor. COVERAGE GAP: Oo2022 is OSCC Boyden chamber (distant indication, isolated process) giving 900x lower estimate than clinical PDAC. Need: additional human PDAC clinical target. Look for studies reporting MDSC density or fraction in resected PDAC tumors (IHC for CD33+/CD11b+ or flow cytometry of digested tumor tissue). Can derive recruitment rate via steady-state balance with MDSC death. A second clinical PDAC target would help anchor Hong2015 (mouse) vs Porembka2012 (human). Model parameter is k_MDSC_rec in cell/(milliliter*day).

MDSC recruitment rate. Need: in vivo syngeneic PDAC model (KPC or Panc02) reporting MDSC infiltration kinetics over time. Time-course data (not just endpoint) would allow direct rate estimation rather than steady-state assumption. Look for studies with longitudinal MDSC quantification in growing pancreatic tumors. Model parameter is k_MDSC_rec in cell/(milliliter*day).

Activated PSC death rate. COVERAGE GAP: both existing targets (Xiao2015, Estaras2021) use pharmacological stimulus (RA, melatonin) on isolated primary PSCs. No endogenous/physiological target. Need: PSC turnover under physiological conditions. Look for studies measuring: (1) PSC half-life or apoptotic fraction in intact PDAC tissue (TUNEL or caspase-3 IHC of alpha-SMA+ cells), (2) untreated PSC viability curves in culture (control arms of drug studies), or (3) CAF turnover rates estimated from Ki-67/apoptotic index in desmoplastic stroma. Model parameter is k_apsc_death in 1/day.
